sentences.text: Bayomesasuchus hernandezi is a rare early crocodile relative known from broken bones. It stands as one of the most primitive members of its family group.
Scientists named this animal in 2015 after a mountain and an ancient crocodile deity. The only known specimen includes parts of the head and lower jaw.
Evolutionary studies place it in a complex branching pattern with African and South American relatives.
This creature lived between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago during the Turonian stage.
